editorial:
Picture a young man who discovers he can rewind his own life like a video tape. That is the heart of this warm, funny, and deeply moving story. Tim is an awkward, kind-hearted guy who learns from his dad that the men in their family can travel back in time. He cannot change big history, but he can fix his own mistakes, like a terrible first impression or a missed chance at love. The vibe is cozy and British, full of rainy beaches, family dinners, and gentle humor. You will fall for the sweet romance with Mary, but the real magic is the bond between Tim and his father. It feels like a hug in movie form.

The acting is wonderful, especially Bill Nighy as the dad, who brings warmth and quiet wisdom to every scene. The pacing is relaxed, so if you want explosions, look elsewhere. Some moments feel a bit too neat, and the time rules can get confusing. Still, it is a beautiful reminder to slow down and enjoy ordinary days. Perfect for date nights or cozy weekends. Stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray.
endingExplained: In the final act, Tim's father is dying and Tim realizes he can no longer visit him in the past, because going back before his third child was born would erase that child. After saying goodbye, Tim stops using time travel altogether. He chooses to live each day only once, but with full attention and gratitude. The last scenes show him enjoying simple moments with his wife and kids, walking on the beach, proving the real lesson was never about fixing mistakes, but about being present.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves heartfelt romances and stories about family.
